items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Only others I remember was Fats Waller made it.

ctx.x: I'll be damned. Seems like somebody would have mentioned that to you.

Only ones they mentioned -- I knew about Earl, we recorded it about two or three different times. Only others I remember was Fats Waller made it. And who else, somebody else made it. I forgot who it was now. I was surprised.
